capabilities: Parse PDF, Office, and image files into Markdown from the file explorer context menu
Choose among seven parsing backends (MinerU cloud, markitdown, docling, vision LLM OCR, Baidu OCR, TextIn, Doc2X)
Batch parse multi-file selections with backend-aware concurrency
Configure Markdown and attachment save paths with {filename}, {date}, and {noteName} variables
Rename extracted image attachments using templates
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not limited to MinerU; it supports seven parsing backends including local CLIs, vision LLMs, and Baidu/TextIn/Doc2X services.
extras: Desktop-only. Recommended installation is via BRAT as a beta plugin. Roughly half the README is written in Chinese. Local backends require a local Python install; MinerU's free mode is capped at 10MB/20 pages without a token.
problem: Obsidian cannot natively convert PDFs, Office files, or images into Markdown notes with extracted image attachments.

relations.evidence: markitdown（本地）— 调用本地 Python CLI，仅桌面端，不提取图片。
docling（本地）— 调用本地 Python CLI，仅桌面端，输出 Markdown，不提取图片。
Doc2X（文档解析）— Doc2X 文档解析接口，擅长 PDF 的公式 / 表格 / 版面

requires.name: MinerU token, OpenAI-compatible vision API key, Baidu AK/SK, TextIn App ID/Secret Code, or Doc2X API key

summary: Document parser that converts PDFs, Office files, and images into Markdown via seven backends, saving notes and image attachments to configurable folders.
